Layer 4 (variance): null-model dispersion and its decomposition

Source: R/estimateVariance.R
estimateVariance.Rd

For every comparison, fits the null model (design without the condition term) with edgeR to get the pseudobulk negative-binomial dispersion phi_total, then splits it into a cell-heterogeneity term (theta/n, with the cell-level theta estimated at pbSetup()) and a between-donor term phi_donor via the moment estimate phi_donor = max(0, phi_total - theta * mean(1/n)). Reports the per-gene fits needed by estimateSensitivity() and a per-comparison summary of the variance shares (depth, cell, donor) with a regime label.

Usage

estimateVariance(x)

Arguments

x

A S4Vectors::SimpleList from pbSetup().

Value

A list with summary (a data.frame, one row per comparison) and pergene (a named list of per-comparison fit objects for sensitivity).
